ios.desc:
Transform your photos into stunning masterpieces with Luca - the privacy-first photo editor that works entirely on your device. No internet required, no cloud uploads, just pure creative control.

EFFORTLESS PROFESSIONAL EDITING
Turn everyday snapshots into gallery-worthy images with just a few taps. Whether you're perfecting Instagram posts, creating TikTok content, or preserving memories, Luca gives you pro-level tools without the complexity.

100+ CURATED FILTERS & PRESETS
From vintage film looks to modern minimalist aesthetics, explore professionally crafted filters that enhance every photo style. Each filter is carefully designed to bring out the best in portraits, landscapes, food, and lifestyle photography.

POWERFUL EDITING TOOLS
- Advanced adjustment sliders for brightness, contrast, saturation, and more
- Precise color correction with white balance and tone controls
- Professional-grade HSL (Hue/Saturation/Lightness) editing
- Smart cropping with preset aspect ratios
- Instant before/after comparison to see your changes
- Unlimited undo - experiment freely without worry

BLACK & WHITE MASTERY
- 15+ monochrome filters for dramatic, timeless photos
- Fine-tune contrast and grain for classic film aesthetics
- Perfect for portraits, architecture, and artistic photography

DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE
- Intuitive interface - no tutorials needed
- Lightning-fast performance, even on older devices
- Full RAW photo support for DSLR enthusiasts
- Export in high quality for printing or sharing
- Works completely offline - edit anywhere, anytime

PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
Your photos never leave your device. No cloud uploads, no data collection, no accounts required. What you create stays yours.

Perfect for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, Snapchat, Twitter, and all your favorite platforms. Download Luca and unlock your creative potential today.
